title: 4sum
description:
Given an array nums of n integers, return an array of all the unique quadruplets [nums[a], nums[b], nums[c], nums[d]] such that:

0 <= a, b, c, d < n
a, b, c, and d are distinct.
nums[a] + nums[b] + nums[c] + nums[d] == target

You may return the answer in any order.
output_format: Print the two-dimensional array of quadruplets. Each quadruplet should be printed in a new line and the numbers in the quadruplet should be space-separated.Print each quadruplet enclosed in brackets, separated by spaces. You must sort the elements inside each quadruplet in ascending order, and you must print the quadruplets themselves sorted in lexicographical (ascending) order.
